## About
Rayco Auto Interiors & Accessories is on Central Avenue in St. Petersburg. We work on car seats, convertible tops, sunroofs, boat seats and covers, and furniture. If it has upholstery, we can probably help.
Stains from the kids, damage from keys, a boat seat that's seen too much sun. We know all types of materials, so you can change the color, style and texture to get the look you want, at a fair price.
Stop in and talk to Bud or Ryan. Customers rate us 4.3 on Google from 69 reviews, and the estimate is free.

## Services
- Auto Upholstery: Fresh car upholstery for seats, door panels and headliners. Get rid of stains and key damage and bring your vehicle back to near new condition.
- Convertible Tops: Convertible tops, moon roofs and sunroofs taken care of. One reviewer had the soft top on a Miata replaced.
- Marine Upholstery: Strip away old, damaged seats and materials and refinish the upholstery throughout your boat.
- Canvas tops and covers: Customized boat covers and canvas tops to protect your boat.
- Furniture Upholstery: Change the color, style and texture of your furniture by replacing the upholstery, with careful attention to detail.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give estimates?
A: Yes. Every project starts with a free estimate for the service you need. Call today to get started.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Monday through Friday we're open 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Sunday.

Q: Do you handle small repairs?
A: We do. One customer stopped in and had a door panel fixed, and another had a chewed dog seatbelt attachment repaired.

Q: Do you work on boats?
A: Yes. We replace old, damaged seats and materials throughout your boat and make customized boat covers.
